tables.name: billing_checkouts
checks: (owner_kind = 'org' AND org_id IS NOT NULL) OR (owner_kind = 'account' AND account_id IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: billing_commerce_orders
checks: subtotal_minor>=0 AND discount_minor>=0 AND tax_minor>=0 AND total_minor=subtotal_minor-discount_minor+tax_minor

tables.name: billing_invoices
checks: (owner_kind = 'org' AND org_id IS NOT NULL) OR (owner_kind = 'account' AND account_id IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: billing_program
checks: enabled = 0 OR starts_at IS NOT NULL

tables.name: billing_subscriptions
checks: (owner_kind = 'org' AND org_id IS NOT NULL) OR (owner_kind = 'account' AND account_id IS NOT NULL)
